== .simpleIf (line 5)
| simpleIf(a)
  alternative
    | a > 0?
    -
      instruction
        | a := 1
    -
  jump
    | return a

== .elseIfChain (line 13)
| elseIfChain(a)
  alternative
    | a < 0?
    -
      jump
        | return -1
    -
      alternative
        | a == 0?
        -
          jump
            | return 0
        -
          jump
            | return 1

== .counting (line 24)
| counting(n)
  instruction
    | sum := 0
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := 0 to n - 1
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + i
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := n to 1 by -1
    -
      instruction
        | sum := sum - i
  jump
    | return sum

== .whileLoop (line 37)
| whileLoop(n)
  while
    | n > 10?
    -
      instruction
        | n := n / 2
  repeat
    | !(n > 0)?
    -
      instruction
        | n := n - 1
  jump
    | return n

== .classic (line 48)
| classic(day)
  instruction
    | r := 0
  case
    | day?
    | 1
    | 2, 3
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | r := 10
    -
      instruction
        | r := 20
    -
      instruction
        | r := 0
  jump
    | return r

== .fallthrough (line 65)
| fallthrough(a)
  instruction
    | r := 0
  case
    | a?
    | 1
    | 2
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | r := r + 1
      instruction
        | r := r + 2
    -
      instruction
        | r := r + 2
    -
      instruction
        | r := -1
  jump
    | return r

== .calls (line 81)
| calls(n)
  call
    | helper(n, 1)
  instruction
    | total := helper(n, 2) + 1
  instruction
    | printf("%d\n", total)

== .helper (line 88)
| helper(a, b)
  jump
    | return a + b
